messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate edges for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "used after"
set: ["used after", "used in population", "not used for", "used in combination with", "may be used for", "used alone or in combination with", "must be used in combination with", "used off label to improve symptoms of", "has other uses", "use with caution in", "has use indication", "should be replaced with", "has usage instruction", "helps remove", "should be made with", "reduces risk of"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the edges set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best edge name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the edges set
